testcase.name: server cancellation returning late cannot stop a successor dispatch
same drain cannot launch queued input before the first handler settles
unconfirmed server Stop of a persisted approval retains waiting external and cursor
same run activation claimed before Stop event CAS keeps both owners running
sending during cancelled handler cleanup waits before its next wire and still executes
registered generation task cancels only the run captured by its hook
